rules.title: Expired X.509 Server Certificate
rules.remediation: Renew and deploy an active, valid server certificate.

rules.title: Certificate Not Yet Valid
rules.description: Certificate not_before timestamp is in the future relative to observation.
rules.remediation: Verify server clock synchronization (NTP) and issuance dates.

rules.title: Insufficient RSA Public Key Length (< 2048 bits)
rules.description: RSA public key modulus is less than 2048 bits.
rules.remediation: Re-issue certificate with an RSA key of at least 2048 bits or ECDSA >= 256 bits.

rules.title: Weak Signature Algorithm in Certificate (MD5 / SHA-1)
rules.description: Certificate signed using deprecated hash algorithm (MD5 or SHA-1).
rules.remediation: Re-issue certificate signed using SHA-256 or stronger digest.

rules.title: Self-Signed Server Certificate
rules.description: Subject DN equals Issuer DN; certificate signature is self-asserted.
rules.remediation: Deploy a certificate issued by a recognized public or enterprise CA.

rules.title: Certificate Identity (SAN) Does Not Match Observed TLS SNI
rules.description: Certificate identity (SAN) does not match the observed TLS server name (SNI).
rules.remediation: Ensure server certificate includes the targeted hostname in Subject Alternative Names.

rules.title: Certificate Chain Path Validation Failed
rules.description: Certificate chain could not be validated offline against the configured trust store.
rules.remediation: Ensure server bundles intermediate certificates and deploy certificates issued by a recognized CA.

rules.title: Certificate Explicitly Revoked in Captured OCSP Response
rules.description: Stapled OCSP response in TLS handshake indicates certificate status is REVOKED.
rules.remediation: Immediately revoke, replace, and deploy a valid server certificate.
